pull_requests.title: fix: correct checkout-service connection pool settings
pull_requests.description: Increase max_connections from 10 to 100 and reduce idle timeout to prevent pool exhaustion under load

pull_requests.title: fix: isolate auth token cache from feature flag cache namespace
pull_requests.description: Separate Redis namespace for auth tokens with volatile-lru eviction policy to prevent feature flag operations from evicting authentication data

pull_requests.title: fix: add payment gateway URL validation and rollback procedure
pull_requests.description: Add URL format and health-check validation for payment gateway config; implement automated pre-activation check; add one-click rollback for critical config changes

pull_requests.title: feat: implement staggered CDN cache invalidation with rate limiting
pull_requests.description: Add configurable rate limiter for cache invalidation requests; implement background cache warming for top-1000 queries after bulk invalidation

pull_requests.title: fix: implement static partition assignment for notification consumers
pull_requests.description: Replace dynamic partition assignment with static assignment in notification-service consumer group; add dead-letter queue with automatic retry for failed deliveries

pull_requests.title: fix: restore per-customer rate limit scope and add config validation
pull_requests.description: Fix rate limiter scope from global to per-customer; add integration test asserting rate limit scoping; add config schema validation for limit scope field

pull_requests.title: fix: prevent analytics pipeline event double-counting via improved idempotency keys
pull_requests.description: Include event timestamp in idempotency key hash; add daily reconciliation job comparing analytics totals with checkout transaction log; add alerting for discrepancy > 0.1%

pull_requests.title: fix: make media-service v3 API backward compatible
pull_requests.description: Maintain v2 API endpoints alongside v3; add API version negotiation header; add backward compatibility integration tests

pull_requests.title: fix: restrict email-service SMTP relay to authenticated service accounts
pull_requests.description: Replace network-range-based SMTP relay ACL with service-account authentication; add relay attempt logging and alerting for unauthorized senders; add weekly automated relay config audit

pull_requests.title: fix: add distributed locking for media-service asset namespace writes
pull_requests.description: Implement Redis-based distributed lock for asset namespace writes; add duplicate asset detection cron job; add asset count reconciliation alerting

pull_requests.title: feat: implement automated multi-region failover for critical infrastructure services
pull_requests.description: Add automated health-check-based failover for log-aggregator, cdn-proxy, and notification-service; implement cross-region data replication with 30s RPO; add regional failover runbook to incident response playbook
